versions.text:
kind: blueprint
name: billing

# Bound once per request by the application, never by the program.
variables:
  customerId:
    required: true

packages:
- '@pied-piper/billing'

# The billing fixture, read-only, from the project's `billing` volume
# (submilli/volumes/billing/).
vfs:
  mode: ephemeral
  mounts:
    /billing:
      mode: named
      volume: billing
      access: read_only

default: deny

permissions:
  # What generated code may do.
  main:
  - name: charges-for-signed-in-customer
    capability: pied-piper.example/charges.list
    filter: customerId == ${vars.customerId}
    action: allow
  - name: local-status
    capability: http.get
    filter: host == "127.0.0.1"
    action: allow
  - name: globex-support
    capability: pied-piper.example/charges.list
    filter: customerId == "cus_globex"
    action: allow
  - name: pied-piper-support
    capability: pied-piper.example/charges.list
    filter: customerId == "cus_pied-piper"
    action: allow

  # What the package itself may do: read its fixture.
  '@pied-piper/billing':
  - capability: fs.read
    filter: path == "/billing/charges.json"
    action: allow
  - capability: http.get
    filter: host == "127.0.0.1"
    action: allow
